title: CSCW17 5-round AES-128 Statistical integral / secret S-box

target.description: 5 nonlinear rounds including initial whitening; finalMC omitted (Section2.1). The AES S-box itself is secret; this is a distinct variant, not standard public-S-box AES.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key; no related-key oracle.
setting.plaintext_model: For each of256 candidate Delta=k5[0] XOR k5[13], choose ciphertexts in the120-bit affine set c[0] XOR c[13]=Delta and test four returned32-bit plaintext projections.
assumptions: One unknown128-bit key and an unknown bijective byte S-box; no S-box recovery claimed.

The normal/chi-square error model assumes sufficiently large sample/projection parameters and independent output/structure statistics. Journal PDF9/printed763 footnote2 explicitly notes that strongly related projections can violate this iid condition. Mini-AES moderate-error experiments do not establish the full-AES negligible-error tails.
setting.reference_model: Single-secret-key five-round AES with secret S-box versus a uniform random permutation, using chosen-ciphertext decryption; test the returned-plaintext statistical integral distributions.

time.note: Source treats one simple operation as1/16 one-round encryption; includes four projections and all256 Delta.

memory.note: 4 *2^32 counters,10 bytes per source counter; equals2^33.32 blocks. Preserve the source counter-width assumption.

preprocessing.note: No numerical amount is reported for this resource.

success.description: Source chooses alpha0=alpha1=0.0002,q approximately3.54 and (1-alpha_i)^256 approximately95%; this is its normal/chi-square model, not an independently certified probability. Under independent Delta tests and the source wrong-Delta alpha1 model, exact-one-Delta true acceptance is(1-alpha0)*(1-alpha1)^255; random false acceptance is256*alpha1*(1-alpha1)^255, not simply the per-test alpha1.

field_conflicts.description: Proposition1 states decreasing finite-population moments D*f and2*D*f^2, f=(2^s-N)/(2^s-1), consistent with the scaled chi-square sentence, Corollary1 Eq8 and independently recomputed endpoints. The final proof line instead prints reciprocal factors f^-1 and f^-2.
